tuples.episode_object: the weathering of the carved surfaces compared with the stone's other faces
tuples.time_place_scope: a physical examination of the cut marks

tuples.evidence_lens: the surface analysis compared with the geological weathering rates

tuples.episode_object: the community that has defended the object for a century

tuples.evidence_lens: the local publications compared with the academic assessments

tuples.episode_object: an ossuary inscription that appeared on the antiquities market

tuples.mechanism: an unprovenanced object, which cannot be authenticated by inspection alone
tuples.evidence_lens: the patina analysis compared with the object's stated history

tuples.episode_object: the trial that examined whether an inscription had been added
tuples.time_place_scope: a criminal proceeding about antiquities

tuples.evidence_lens: the material analysis compared with the textual assessment

tuples.episode_object: the collector whose acquisitions have repeatedly proved doubtful
tuples.time_place_scope: a collection assembled through a single supply chain
tuples.mechanism: a pattern across a collection, which is stronger evidence than any single object
tuples.evidence_lens: the collection's acquisition records compared with the assessments of each object

tuples.episode_object: the museum that withdrew objects from display after a review
tuples.time_place_scope: an institution acting on its own examination
tuples.mechanism: an institutional withdrawal, which is honest and rarely publicised
tuples.evidence_lens: the review findings compared with the display history

tuples.episode_object: a boundary stone with an inscription in two scripts
tuples.time_place_scope: an object of genuine antiquity with a contested reading
tuples.mechanism: a reading dispute rather than an authenticity dispute, which is a different problem
tuples.evidence_lens: the successive readings compared with the surface as recorded

tuples.episode_object: the squeeze taken in the nineteenth century before the stone eroded
tuples.time_place_scope: a paper impression preserving a lost surface
tuples.mechanism: an old record preserving evidence, which is often the only surviving reading
tuples.evidence_lens: the squeeze compared with the stone's present condition

tuples.episode_object: the inscription that was recut during a restoration
tuples.time_place_scope: a monument whose text was renewed by a later hand
tuples.mechanism: a recutting, which converts an original into a copy without a record
tuples.evidence_lens: the restoration accounts compared with the text as it now reads

tuples.episode_object: the forger who was identified by a distinctive letter form
tuples.time_place_scope: a body of objects sharing a single habit
tuples.mechanism: a hand identified across objects, which unmasks a whole corpus
tuples.evidence_lens: the letter forms compared across the objects attributed to one source

tuples.episode_object: the object accepted for decades and rejected after a technical advance
tuples.time_place_scope: a case resolved by a method that did not exist before
tuples.mechanism: a technical advance settling an old dispute, which is how most of these end
tuples.evidence_lens: the new analysis compared with the earlier assessments

tuples.episode_object: the object rejected for decades and later accepted
tuples.time_place_scope: a case where the initial scepticism was wrong
tuples.mechanism: a reversal in the other direction, which happens and is rarely reported
tuples.evidence_lens: the modern analysis compared with the original rejection

tuples.episode_object: the excavation record that would have settled it and does not exist

tuples.evidence_lens: the object compared with the standards for a documented find

tuples.episode_object: the publication that presented the object as certain
tuples.time_place_scope: an academic paper without adequate caveats

tuples.evidence_lens: the publication compared with the evidence it presented

tuples.episode_object: the replica made for display and later mistaken for the original
tuples.time_place_scope: a museum copy that entered circulation
tuples.mechanism: a copy misidentified, which produces a phantom second object
tuples.evidence_lens: the accession records compared with the objects in circulation

tuples.episode_object: the case for treating provenance as the first question
tuples.time_place_scope: a discipline whose central methodological rule this is
tuples.mechanism: an evidentiary priority, which resolves most authenticity questions before analysis
tuples.evidence_lens: the provenance records compared with the technical analyses

coverage_profiles.subject: relics that have been tested and tested again

tuples.episode_object: a cloth bearing a faint image, examined by many disciplines
tuples.time_place_scope: an object held by an institution and studied intensively

tuples.evidence_lens: the successive published analyses compared with each other

tuples.episode_object: the argument that the sample came from a repaired area
tuples.time_place_scope: a proposal that the tested material was not original

tuples.evidence_lens: the sample location compared with the textile analysis of the area

tuples.episode_object: the textile analysis of the weave and its known parallels
tuples.time_place_scope: a technical study of the fabric's construction

tuples.episode_object: the pollen study and the questions raised about its method
tuples.time_place_scope: an analysis of material recovered from the surface

tuples.evidence_lens: the pollen results compared with the methodological critiques

tuples.episode_object: the image-formation hypotheses and what each would predict

tuples.episode_object: the institution's own position on what the object is
tuples.time_place_scope: a holder declining to make a determination

tuples.episode_object: a piece of wood venerated in several churches at once

tuples.time_place_scope: an institution recording a purchase

tuples.evidence_lens: the required sample size compared with the object's dimensions

tuples.mechanism: a financial interest in an outcome, which is a fact and not an accusation

tuples.episode_object: the tests that were proposed and never funded

tuples.episode_object: the sound heard underwater and recorded by a monitoring array
tuples.time_place_scope: a hydrophone network built for treaty verification
tuples.mechanism: an acoustic detection outside the design purpose, which is hard to attribute
tuples.evidence_lens: the hydrophone records compared with the catalogue of known sources

tuples.episode_object: the whale vocalisation at an unusual frequency
tuples.time_place_scope: a single animal recorded over many years
tuples.mechanism: a biological source with an unusual characteristic, which was identified and remains unexplained
tuples.evidence_lens: the acoustic records compared with the known vocalisations of the species

tuples.episode_object: the noise complaint records that predate the reported phenomenon
tuples.time_place_scope: a district with a documented complaint history
tuples.mechanism: an administrative record providing a baseline, which is rarely consulted
tuples.evidence_lens: the complaint records compared with the reported onset of the phenomenon

tuples.episode_object: the psychoacoustic explanation and its reception
tuples.time_place_scope: a proposal locating the phenomenon in perception
tuples.mechanism: a perceptual explanation, which is often correct and never welcome
tuples.evidence_lens: the clinical literature compared with the residents' accounts

tuples.episode_object: the sound that stopped when a plant changed its operating schedule
tuples.time_place_scope: a case resolved by an operational change
tuples.mechanism: a resolution by coincidence, which is how many of these end
tuples.evidence_lens: the plant's operating records compared with the complaint dates

tuples.episode_object: the monitoring station installed at public expense and its findings
tuples.time_place_scope: a local authority responding to sustained complaints
tuples.mechanism: a public investigation, which produces data and rarely satisfaction
tuples.evidence_lens: the monitoring data compared with the complaints received

tuples.episode_object: the phenomenon reported in many countries with the same description
tuples.time_place_scope: a global set of reports with a common vocabulary
tuples.mechanism: a shared description, which may indicate a shared cause or a shared vocabulary
tuples.evidence_lens: the international reports compared for their wording and their measurements

tuples.episode_object: the case for separating the sound from the explanation
tuples.time_place_scope: a subject where a real observation attracts unreal accounts
tuples.mechanism: a distinction between observation and interpretation, which is the working method
tuples.evidence_lens: the acoustic measurements compared with the explanations offered

coverage_profiles.subject: fires and lights with no established source

tuples.episode_object: a fire that broke out repeatedly in one house over several weeks
tuples.time_place_scope: a property investigated by a fire service and a police force
tuples.mechanism: a repeated ignition in one place, which almost always has a human cause
tuples.evidence_lens: the fire investigation reports compared with the household's own account

tuples.episode_object: the investigation that considered and excluded the electrical system
tuples.time_place_scope: a property examined by an electrical engineer
tuples.mechanism: a systematic exclusion, which narrows the possibilities properly
tuples.evidence_lens: the electrical inspection compared with the ignition points recorded

tuples.episode_object: the pattern of ignitions and who was present at each
tuples.time_place_scope: a set of events with a documented attendance
tuples.mechanism: a correlation with presence, which is the standard investigative approach
tuples.evidence_lens: the incident timeline compared with the occupants' movements

tuples.episode_object: a light seen on a marsh at night and reported for centuries
tuples.time_place_scope: a wetland district with a long-recorded phenomenon
tuples.mechanism: a phenomenon with a well-supported chemical explanation, still occasionally reported
tuples.evidence_lens: the historical reports compared with the modern chemical explanation

tuples.episode_object: the gas composition measured at such sites
tuples.time_place_scope: a wetland sampled for methane and phosphine
tuples.mechanism: a measurement supporting a mechanism, which has been reproduced in a laboratory
tuples.evidence_lens: the field measurements compared with the laboratory reproductions

tuples.episode_object: a light reported along a railway line by many separate witnesses
tuples.time_place_scope: a district with a persistent and much-visited phenomenon
tuples.mechanism: a sighting series with a proposed optical cause, which is contested locally
tuples.evidence_lens: the sighting reports compared with the optical experiments conducted

tuples.episode_object: the experiment that produced the same light with vehicle headlamps
tuples.time_place_scope: a controlled test conducted on the site
tuples.mechanism: a reproduction using an ordinary source, which is decisive and disbelieved
tuples.evidence_lens: the experiment records compared with the traditional accounts

tuples.episode_object: a glow reported over a mountain range before earthquakes
tuples.time_place_scope: a seismically active region with historical reports
tuples.mechanism: a phenomenon with laboratory support and poor field documentation
tuples.evidence_lens: the historical reports compared with the laboratory work on rock stress

tuples.episode_object: the photographs taken of such lights and what they show
tuples.time_place_scope: a set of images with long exposures
tuples.mechanism: a photographic record with severe interpretive limits, which is typical
tuples.evidence_lens: the photographs compared with the exposure conditions recorded

tuples.episode_object: a fire that destroyed a building with an unexplained rapid spread
tuples.time_place_scope: a structure examined after a total loss
tuples.mechanism: a spread rate requiring an explanation, which materials analysis usually supplies
tuples.evidence_lens: the fire investigation compared with the building's material specification

tuples.episode_object: the accelerant testing that found nothing
tuples.time_place_scope: a laboratory examination of debris
tuples.mechanism: a null result on accelerants, which excludes one hypothesis only
tuples.evidence_lens: the laboratory results compared with the hypotheses considered

tuples.episode_object: a light reported hovering over a valley for several nights
tuples.time_place_scope: a district where an object was visible repeatedly
tuples.mechanism: a repeated sighting at a fixed location, which is unusually easy to investigate
tuples.evidence_lens: the sighting reports compared with the astronomical positions

tuples.episode_object: the planet that was rising in the same direction on those nights
tuples.time_place_scope: an astronomical position matching the sighting bearings
tuples.mechanism: a straightforward astronomical explanation, which fits most such reports
tuples.evidence_lens: the astronomical positions compared with the reported bearings

tuples.episode_object: a ball of light reported inside an aircraft cabin
tuples.time_place_scope: a documented category of report from crews
tuples.mechanism: a rare phenomenon reported by credible witnesses, which is poorly understood
tuples.evidence_lens: the incident reports compared with the experimental literature

tuples.episode_object: the laboratory work that produced comparable luminous phenomena
tuples.time_place_scope: a set of experiments generating short-lived luminous balls
tuples.mechanism: an experimental reproduction, which establishes plausibility and not identity
tuples.evidence_lens: the laboratory results compared with the reported observations

tuples.episode_object: a burning that left a body damaged and the room largely intact
tuples.time_place_scope: a domestic scene examined by an investigator
tuples.mechanism: a phenomenon with a well-supported mundane explanation, still widely misreported
tuples.evidence_lens: the investigation findings compared with the forensic literature

tuples.episode_object: the wick effect demonstrated experimentally
tuples.time_place_scope: a set of controlled experiments on combustion
tuples.mechanism: a mechanism demonstrated, which fully explains the reported pattern
tuples.evidence_lens: the experimental results compared with the scene descriptions

tuples.episode_object: the coroner's finding and the way it was reported
tuples.time_place_scope: a legal determination summarised inaccurately in coverage
tuples.mechanism: a finding misreported, which creates a mystery from a resolved case
tuples.evidence_lens: the coroner's record compared with the published accounts

tuples.episode_object: the site that was monitored for a year with instruments
tuples.time_place_scope: a location subjected to a systematic observation programme
tuples.mechanism: a monitored site, which produces the only reliable data on such phenomena
tuples.evidence_lens: the monitoring data compared with the sighting reports from the same period

tuples.episode_object: the case for distinguishing an unexplained event from an inexplicable one
tuples.time_place_scope: a subject where the two are constantly conflated
tuples.mechanism: a distinction between not explained and not explicable, which is the whole argument
tuples.evidence_lens: the investigated cases compared with the language used to describe them

coverage_profiles.subject: things that fell out of the sky

tuples.episode_object: a fall of small fish onto a town during a storm
tuples.time_place_scope: a district with a documented and dated event
tuples.mechanism: a fall with a proposed meteorological mechanism, which is plausible and rarely observed
tuples.evidence_lens: the contemporary reports compared with the meteorological records

tuples.episode_object: the waterspout mechanism and how often it has been seen to work
tuples.time_place_scope: a phenomenon capable of lifting water and its contents
tuples.mechanism: a mechanism observed in part and never end to end, which is the honest position
tuples.evidence_lens: the observed waterspout behaviour compared with the reported falls

tuples.episode_object: a fall of frogs reported in several separate countries
tuples.time_place_scope: a phenomenon reported across a wide geographic range
tuples.mechanism: a repeated report type, which suggests a real mechanism rather than a local story
tuples.evidence_lens: the international reports compared for their common circumstances

tuples.episode_object: the identification of the species and where they must have come from
tuples.time_place_scope: a fall whose material was collected and examined
tuples.mechanism: a species identification, which locates a source and tests the mechanism
tuples.evidence_lens: the species identification compared with the regional distribution

tuples.episode_object: a fall of coloured rain reported over a wide area
tuples.time_place_scope: a region where rain was reported with an unusual colour
tuples.mechanism: a coloured precipitation event, which usually has an atmospheric dust explanation
tuples.evidence_lens: the rainwater analysis compared with the dust transport records

tuples.episode_object: the desert dust transport that explains most such events
tuples.time_place_scope: an atmospheric process moving material across continents
tuples.mechanism: a documented transport mechanism, which explains the geography of these reports
tuples.evidence_lens: the atmospheric transport records compared with the reported events

tuples.episode_object: a fall of a gelatinous material examined and identified
tuples.time_place_scope: a substance collected and submitted to a laboratory
tuples.mechanism: a material identification, which usually finds a biological or industrial source
tuples.evidence_lens: the laboratory analysis compared with the popular descriptions

tuples.episode_object: a fall of ice from a clear sky near an air route
tuples.time_place_scope: a location beneath a busy airway
tuples.mechanism: a plausible aviation source, which is investigated by the aviation authority
tuples.evidence_lens: the aviation reports compared with the flight tracks over the site

tuples.episode_object: the aircraft icing mechanism and how it is documented
tuples.time_place_scope: a technical process with an established literature
tuples.mechanism: an established mechanism, which explains most such reports near airways
tuples.evidence_lens: the technical literature compared with the reported incidents

tuples.episode_object: a fall of ice far from any air route
tuples.time_place_scope: an event in a location with no aviation explanation
tuples.mechanism: an event without the usual explanation, which requires another mechanism
tuples.evidence_lens: the flight records compared with the site's position

tuples.episode_object: a meteorite fall witnessed and the fragments recovered
tuples.time_place_scope: an event with many witnesses and physical material
tuples.mechanism: a fully resolved fall, which is the standard against which the others are judged
tuples.evidence_lens: the recovered material compared with the witness accounts

tuples.episode_object: the meteorite that was reported and never found
tuples.time_place_scope: an event with a bright trail and no recovery
tuples.mechanism: a witnessed event with no material, which is common and unremarkable
tuples.evidence_lens: the trajectory reconstruction compared with the search conducted

tuples.episode_object: a fall of industrial material traced to a nearby plant
tuples.time_place_scope: a district downwind of a specific facility
tuples.mechanism: an industrial source identified, which resolves a case completely
tuples.evidence_lens: the plant's emission records compared with the deposition pattern

tuples.episode_object: the material that turned out to be from a passing aircraft's waste system
tuples.time_place_scope: an event with a distinctive and identifiable material
tuples.mechanism: an identification that resolves a case and embarrasses everyone
tuples.evidence_lens: the material analysis compared with the aircraft's servicing records

tuples.episode_object: a fall reported in a period of intense newspaper competition
tuples.time_place_scope: an era with a strong incentive to print marvels
tuples.mechanism: a reporting environment producing reports, which is a real confounder
tuples.evidence_lens: the newspaper reports compared with the corroborating records

tuples.episode_object: the collector who catalogued such reports over decades
tuples.time_place_scope: a compiler assembling anomalies from the press
tuples.mechanism: a catalogue with an explicit editorial stance, which is a source and not a record
tuples.evidence_lens: the catalogue entries compared with the original newspaper reports

tuples.episode_object: the fall that was collected, preserved and analysed properly
tuples.time_place_scope: an event handled by people who knew what to do
tuples.mechanism: a well-handled event, which produces an answer and rarely a story
tuples.evidence_lens: the analysis results compared with the collection method

tuples.episode_object: the difficulty of establishing that something fell at all
tuples.time_place_scope: a category where the observation itself is often the weak point
tuples.mechanism: an unwitnessed fall, which cannot be distinguished from material already present
tuples.evidence_lens: the witness statements compared with the site as examined

tuples.episode_object: the modern reports supported by video from several angles
tuples.time_place_scope: a period with abundant recording capability
tuples.mechanism: an evidentiary abundance, which resolves modern cases quickly
tuples.evidence_lens: the video records compared with the trajectory reconstructions

tuples.episode_object: the case for asking first whether the fall was observed
tuples.time_place_scope: a methodological point that resolves a large share of these reports
tuples.mechanism: an evidentiary priority, which is simple and almost never applied
tuples.evidence_lens: the reports compared with the presence or absence of a witnessed fall

coverage_profiles.subject: warnings that were on file before the event

tuples.episode_object: an engineering memorandum written months before a structural failure
tuples.time_place_scope: an organisation whose internal record contains the objection
tuples.mechanism: a documented warning, which converts a disaster into a governance question
tuples.evidence_lens: the internal memorandum compared with the inquiry's findings

tuples.episode_object: the meeting at which the objection was recorded and overruled
tuples.time_place_scope: a decision taken with the concern minuted
tuples.mechanism: a minuted dissent, which is the strongest evidence an inquiry can find
tuples.evidence_lens: the minutes compared with the decision as implemented

tuples.episode_object: the inspection report that was filed and not read
tuples.time_place_scope: an organisation receiving more reports than it processed
tuples.mechanism: a warning lost to volume, which is the commonest failure mode
tuples.evidence_lens: the report's routing record compared with the actions taken

tuples.episode_object: the whistle-blower who was moved to another department
tuples.time_place_scope: an employee whose concerns were handled administratively
tuples.mechanism: a concern managed rather than answered, which is documented in personnel files
tuples.evidence_lens: the personnel records compared with the technical concern raised

tuples.episode_object: a geological survey that identified a slope as unstable
tuples.time_place_scope: a settlement built below a documented hazard
tuples.mechanism: a hazard documented and not acted on, which is a planning failure
tuples.evidence_lens: the survey report compared with the planning decisions

tuples.episode_object: the planning permission granted despite the survey
tuples.time_place_scope: a consent issued with the report in the file
tuples.mechanism: a decision taken against advice, which is documented and traceable
tuples.evidence_lens: the planning file compared with the technical advice it contained

tuples.episode_object: a meteorological warning issued and not distributed
tuples.time_place_scope: a forecast produced and not communicated
tuples.mechanism: a communication failure, which is distinct from a forecasting failure
tuples.evidence_lens: the forecast record compared with the dissemination log

tuples.episode_object: the warning that used a scale the public did not understand
tuples.time_place_scope: an alert system with technical language
tuples.mechanism: a communication designed for specialists, which fails with a general audience
tuples.evidence_lens: the warning text compared with the public response measured afterwards

tuples.episode_object: a medical device fault reported repeatedly before a recall
tuples.time_place_scope: a regulator receiving individual reports over years
tuples.mechanism: a signal invisible in individual reports, which is the case for aggregation
tuples.evidence_lens: the individual reports compared with the aggregated analysis

tuples.episode_object: the database that would have shown the pattern if it had been queried
tuples.time_place_scope: a regulator holding the data and not analysing it
tuples.mechanism: data held and unexamined, which is a resource failure rather than concealment
tuples.evidence_lens: the database contents compared with the analyses performed

tuples.episode_object: an intelligence report that named a risk in general terms
tuples.time_place_scope: an assessment written before an event that matched it loosely
tuples.mechanism: a general warning read as specific in hindsight, which is a hindsight problem
tuples.evidence_lens: the original report compared with the event it is said to predict

tuples.episode_object: the base rate of such warnings and how many are followed by nothing
tuples.time_place_scope: a stream of assessments most of which describe events that do not occur
tuples.mechanism: a base rate problem, which is why prediction claims are usually empty
tuples.evidence_lens: the full set of warnings compared with the outcomes that followed

tuples.episode_object: a safety recommendation made after an earlier accident and not implemented
tuples.time_place_scope: a regulator whose recommendations are advisory
tuples.mechanism: an unimplemented recommendation, which is documented and recurs across industries
tuples.evidence_lens: the recommendation register compared with the implementation records

tuples.episode_object: the cost estimate that was weighed against the risk
tuples.time_place_scope: an organisation making an explicit trade-off
tuples.mechanism: a documented calculation, which is legitimate practice and reads terribly afterwards
tuples.evidence_lens: the internal analysis compared with the outcome

tuples.episode_object: the letter from a member of the public that named the hazard
tuples.time_place_scope: an organisation receiving an unsolicited warning
tuples.mechanism: an outside warning, which is usually filed without analysis
tuples.evidence_lens: the correspondence file compared with the actions taken

tuples.episode_object: the near miss that was recorded and not investigated
tuples.time_place_scope: a reporting system capturing incidents without consequences
tuples.mechanism: a near miss unexamined, which is the cheapest missed opportunity
tuples.evidence_lens: the incident reports compared with the investigations opened

tuples.episode_object: the inquiry that found the warnings were clear in retrospect only
tuples.time_place_scope: an investigation resisting hindsight bias
tuples.mechanism: an honest treatment of hindsight, which is rare and methodologically important
tuples.evidence_lens: the inquiry's reasoning compared with the documents available beforehand

tuples.episode_object: the recommendation register created afterwards to track implementation
tuples.time_place_scope: an organisation building a mechanism in response
tuples.mechanism: a tracking system created by a disaster, which is the durable outcome
tuples.evidence_lens: the register compared with the recommendations it tracks

tuples.episode_object: the same recommendation made after three separate events
tuples.time_place_scope: a sector where a lesson has not been retained
tuples.mechanism: a repeated recommendation, which is the clearest evidence of institutional failure
tuples.evidence_lens: the successive inquiry reports compared for repeated recommendations

tuples.episode_object: the case for reading the file before reading the event
tuples.time_place_scope: a methodological approach to any disaster
tuples.mechanism: a document-first method, which is how these questions are actually answered
tuples.evidence_lens: the pre-event records compared with the post-event narratives

coverage_profiles.subject: cases reopened by a new technique

tuples.episode_object: a decades-old case solved by a genealogical database search
tuples.time_place_scope: a modern method using distant relatives rather than direct matches
tuples.mechanism: a technique that identifies through relatives, which reopened many closed files
tuples.evidence_lens: the identification method compared with the original investigation's limits

tuples.episode_object: the privacy questions that the method raised immediately
tuples.time_place_scope: a technique using data submitted for other purposes
tuples.mechanism: a consent question, which the method's success has not settled
tuples.evidence_lens: the databases' terms compared with the uses made of them

tuples.episode_object: the evidence that survived because a store kept more than required
tuples.time_place_scope: an evidence facility exceeding its retention obligations
tuples.mechanism: retention beyond requirement, which is the precondition for every reopening
tuples.evidence_lens: the retention records compared with the minimum requirements

tuples.episode_object: the sample that had degraded past the point of analysis
tuples.time_place_scope: material stored in unsuitable conditions
tuples.mechanism: degradation preventing analysis, which is the commonest reason a case cannot reopen
tuples.evidence_lens: the storage records compared with the analytical requirements

tuples.episode_object: a body identified from isotope analysis of tooth enamel
tuples.time_place_scope: a technique giving a region of childhood residence
tuples.mechanism: a geographic narrowing, which reduces a candidate list dramatically
tuples.evidence_lens: the isotope results compared with the missing-person records searched

tuples.episode_object: a fingerprint recovered by a chemical method not available before
tuples.time_place_scope: a technique developed for difficult surfaces
tuples.mechanism: a method reaching evidence that was always present, which is the ideal case
tuples.evidence_lens: the recovered print compared with the original examination record

tuples.episode_object: a document dated by an ink analysis that did not exist at the trial
tuples.time_place_scope: a forensic method developed after a conviction
tuples.mechanism: a technique postdating a verdict, which is the basis for many appeals
tuples.evidence_lens: the analysis results compared with the evidence given at trial

tuples.episode_object: a conviction overturned when the technique that supported it was discredited
tuples.time_place_scope: a forensic discipline whose reliability was reassessed
tuples.mechanism: a method withdrawn, which reopens every case that relied on it
tuples.evidence_lens: the discipline's reassessment compared with the convictions it supported

tuples.episode_object: the review of all cases in which the discredited method was used
tuples.time_place_scope: an authority conducting a systematic re-examination
tuples.mechanism: a systematic review, which is expensive and the only responsible response
tuples.evidence_lens: the review's scope compared with the cases identified

tuples.episode_object: a shipwreck identified by a survey technique developed for industry
tuples.time_place_scope: a commercial method applied to a historical question
tuples.mechanism: a technique crossing from industry to research, which is a common route
tuples.evidence_lens: the survey data compared with the historical records

tuples.episode_object: a manuscript read by imaging that recovered erased writing
tuples.time_place_scope: a technique revealing text beneath later writing
tuples.mechanism: a method recovering lost content, which produces genuine new sources
tuples.evidence_lens: the recovered text compared with the visible surface

tuples.episode_object: a painting attributed differently after pigment analysis
tuples.time_place_scope: an artwork examined with modern imaging
tuples.mechanism: a technical attribution, which sometimes overturns a settled view
tuples.evidence_lens: the pigment analysis compared with the traditional attribution

tuples.episode_object: a burial site located by geophysics after a decade of searching
tuples.time_place_scope: a search area narrowed by systematic survey
tuples.mechanism: a survey method locating a target, which resolves a specific question
tuples.evidence_lens: the geophysical data compared with the excavation results

tuples.episode_object: a poisoning identified by a test developed decades afterwards
tuples.time_place_scope: a case where the agent was undetectable at the time
tuples.mechanism: an agent detectable only later, which reopens historical deaths
tuples.evidence_lens: the modern analysis compared with the original toxicology

tuples.episode_object: a case reopened and closed again with the same conclusion
tuples.time_place_scope: a review confirming an original finding
tuples.mechanism: a confirmed original finding, which is the commonest outcome and rarely reported
tuples.evidence_lens: the review findings compared with the original investigation

tuples.episode_object: the family that funded the reanalysis privately
tuples.time_place_scope: relatives paying for work an authority would not
tuples.mechanism: private funding of a public function, which produces results and inequity
tuples.evidence_lens: the funding arrangements compared with the authority's own criteria

tuples.episode_object: the cold case unit established with a defined remit
tuples.time_place_scope: an organisation creating a dedicated capability
tuples.mechanism: an institutional response, which produces results proportional to its funding
tuples.evidence_lens: the unit's remit compared with its case outcomes

tuples.episode_object: the technique that produced a result nobody could interpret
tuples.time_place_scope: a method giving data without a reference set
tuples.mechanism: a result without a comparison, which cannot be used
tuples.evidence_lens: the analytical result compared with the reference data available

tuples.episode_object: the reopening that was announced and quietly abandoned
tuples.time_place_scope: a case revisited without a published outcome
tuples.mechanism: an unreported ending, which leaves a public expectation unmet
tuples.evidence_lens: the announcement compared with the subsequent record

tuples.episode_object: the case for keeping material even when there is no method to use it
tuples.time_place_scope: an archival principle with a strong empirical justification
tuples.mechanism: a preservation argument, which is proved by every case in this list
tuples.evidence_lens: the retention decisions compared with the techniques later developed

coverage_profiles.subject: people who confessed to things they had not done

tuples.episode_object: a confession given after a long uninterrupted interview
tuples.time_place_scope: an interrogation conducted before recording was required
tuples.mechanism: a confession produced by process, which is documented in the psychological literature
tuples.evidence_lens: the interview record compared with the physical evidence

tuples.episode_object: the detail in the confession that only the investigators knew
tuples.time_place_scope: a statement containing information supplied during questioning
tuples.mechanism: contaminated detail, which is the standard test for a false confession
tuples.evidence_lens: the confession content compared with the disclosure record

tuples.episode_object: the requirement to record interviews and what it changed
tuples.time_place_scope: a legal reform following a series of cases
tuples.mechanism: a procedural reform, which reduced a category of miscarriage substantially
tuples.evidence_lens: the pre-reform cases compared with the post-reform record

tuples.episode_object: a confession to a crime that was later shown not to have occurred
tuples.time_place_scope: a case where the underlying event was misclassified
tuples.mechanism: a confession to a non-event, which is the clearest demonstration of the phenomenon
tuples.evidence_lens: the confession compared with the evidence about the event itself

tuples.episode_object: the serial confessor who claimed dozens of unconnected cases
tuples.time_place_scope: a person whose claims were accepted and used to close files
tuples.mechanism: claims used administratively, which closed cases wrongly at scale
tuples.evidence_lens: the closed case files compared with the confessor's documented movements

tuples.episode_object: the movements record that excluded him from most of them
tuples.time_place_scope: a documentary reconstruction of one person's location
tuples.mechanism: a documentary alibi, which is decisive and was available all along
tuples.evidence_lens: the employment and travel records compared with the offence dates

tuples.episode_object: the vulnerable person interviewed without an appropriate adult
tuples.time_place_scope: a case involving a suspect with a recognised vulnerability
tuples.mechanism: a procedural safeguard omitted, which is documented and remediable
tuples.evidence_lens: the interview record compared with the safeguards required

tuples.episode_object: the psychological assessment conducted years afterwards
tuples.time_place_scope: an evaluation performed during an appeal
tuples.mechanism: a late assessment, which explains a confession without excusing the process
tuples.evidence_lens: the assessment compared with the interview record

tuples.episode_object: the confession retracted within days and used at trial anyway
tuples.time_place_scope: a legal system permitting a retracted statement in evidence
tuples.mechanism: an admissibility rule, which is the point at which the harm becomes irreversible
tuples.evidence_lens: the trial record compared with the retraction

tuples.episode_object: the appeal that succeeded twenty years later
tuples.time_place_scope: a case reviewed by a statutory body
tuples.mechanism: a review body with powers of referral, which is how such cases are corrected
tuples.evidence_lens: the referral decision compared with the original trial record

tuples.episode_object: the compensation scheme and the tests an applicant must satisfy
tuples.time_place_scope: a statutory scheme with narrow criteria
tuples.mechanism: a scheme that excludes many of the people it appears designed for
tuples.evidence_lens: the statutory criteria compared with the applications refused

tuples.episode_object: the original investigators' response to the overturning
tuples.time_place_scope: officers maintaining their position after an appeal
tuples.mechanism: a persistent belief after a legal reversal, which is human and consequential
tuples.evidence_lens: the officers' statements compared with the appeal court's findings

tuples.episode_object: the real offender identified afterwards by other evidence
tuples.time_place_scope: a case where the correct answer eventually emerged
tuples.mechanism: a later identification, which proves the earlier confession false conclusively
tuples.evidence_lens: the later evidence compared with the original confession

tuples.episode_object: the case where no alternative was ever identified
tuples.time_place_scope: a conviction overturned without a replacement finding
tuples.mechanism: an overturned conviction with no answer, which leaves everyone dissatisfied
tuples.evidence_lens: the appeal findings compared with the state of the investigation

tuples.episode_object: the study that estimated how often confessions are false
tuples.time_place_scope: a research programme using exoneration data

tuples.episode_object: the person who confessed to protect somebody else

coverage_profiles.subject: claims that were made very late

tuples.episode_object: a statement given by a former official in retirement
tuples.time_place_scope: a person no longer constrained by employment
tuples.mechanism: an account given when the constraints have gone, which is credible and unverifiable
tuples.evidence_lens: the late statement compared with the documentary record

tuples.episode_object: a deathbed claim reported by a relative afterwards
tuples.time_place_scope: a claim with no independent witness
tuples.mechanism: a second-hand deathbed account, which cannot be tested at all
tuples.evidence_lens: the reported claim compared with the documentary record of the events

tuples.episode_object: a memoir published forty years after the events described
tuples.time_place_scope: a narrative reconstructed largely from memory
tuples.mechanism: a memoir as a source, which is valuable and systematically unreliable on detail
tuples.evidence_lens: the memoir compared with the contemporaneous documents

tuples.episode_object: the diary entries that contradict the memoir by the same person
tuples.time_place_scope: an author whose own record disagrees with his later account
tuples.mechanism: self-contradiction across time, which is the most instructive kind of source problem
tuples.evidence_lens: the diary compared with the memoir written later

tuples.episode_object: a claim of participation in a programme with no employment record
tuples.time_place_scope: an assertion that cannot be corroborated administratively
tuples.mechanism: an unverifiable employment claim, which is the weakest form of testimony
tuples.evidence_lens: the employment records compared with the claim as stated

tuples.episode_object: the security clearance records that would settle the question
tuples.time_place_scope: an archive holding the decisive documents
tuples.mechanism: a decisive record that is not accessible, which freezes the question
tuples.evidence_lens: the access requests compared with the responses given

tuples.episode_object: a late identification of a person in a photograph
tuples.time_place_scope: an image identified decades after it was taken
tuples.mechanism: a late identification, which is often correct and hard to confirm
tuples.evidence_lens: the identification compared with the corroborating records

tuples.episode_object: the interview conducted with a witness in their nineties
tuples.time_place_scope: an oral history recorded at the end of a life
tuples.mechanism: a very late oral record, which preserves what would otherwise vanish
tuples.evidence_lens: the interview compared with the documents from the period

tuples.episode_object: the account that improved in detail with each retelling
tuples.time_place_scope: a narrative recorded several times over decades
tuples.mechanism: accretion in a single witness's account, which is measurable across recordings
tuples.evidence_lens: the successive recordings compared with each other

tuples.episode_object: the claim that emerged only after a book was published
tuples.time_place_scope: testimony appearing after a published account was available
tuples.mechanism: testimony following a published narrative, which raises a contamination question
tuples.evidence_lens: the testimony dates compared with the publication dates

tuples.episode_object: the corroborating document produced by the claimant
tuples.time_place_scope: a supporting paper supplied by the person making the claim
tuples.mechanism: a document supplied by an interested party, which requires independent verification
tuples.evidence_lens: the document compared with the archive it should have come from

tuples.episode_object: the claim that was verified by an unrelated archival find
tuples.time_place_scope: testimony independently confirmed by a document
tuples.mechanism: an independent confirmation, which is rare and completely decisive
tuples.evidence_lens: the testimony compared with the archival record found later

tuples.episode_object: the claim about a colleague who is no longer alive to answer
tuples.time_place_scope: an account naming a person who cannot respond
tuples.mechanism: an unanswerable allegation, which should be reported with that stated
tuples.evidence_lens: the claim compared with the documentary record about the person named

tuples.episode_object: the payment received for an exclusive account
tuples.time_place_scope: testimony given under a commercial arrangement
tuples.mechanism: a financial interest in a claim, which is a fact to be disclosed and not a refutation
tuples.evidence_lens: the contract terms compared with the account given

tuples.episode_object: the recantation issued after the account was published
tuples.time_place_scope: a witness withdrawing a claim
tuples.mechanism: a withdrawal, which is as difficult to weigh as the original claim
tuples.evidence_lens: the recantation compared with the published account

tuples.episode_object: the oral history programme that recorded hundreds of such accounts
tuples.time_place_scope: a systematic collection rather than a single testimony
tuples.mechanism: a systematic collection, which allows accounts to be compared with each other
tuples.evidence_lens: the collected accounts compared for their points of agreement

tuples.episode_object: the account that is consistent with every document and adds nothing
tuples.time_place_scope: testimony that neither contradicts nor extends the record
tuples.mechanism: a consistent and uninformative account, which is the commonest outcome
tuples.evidence_lens: the testimony compared with the documents it matches

tuples.episode_object: the family that released papers only after the last participant died
tuples.time_place_scope: a private archive held back by agreement
tuples.mechanism: a deliberate delay, which is a choice about when a record enters history
tuples.evidence_lens: the released papers compared with the public account before release

tuples.episode_object: the interview that was recorded and embargoed for fifty years
tuples.time_place_scope: an account deliberately sealed for a period
tuples.mechanism: an embargoed testimony, which trades immediacy for candour
tuples.evidence_lens: the embargo terms compared with the content when it opens

tuples.episode_object: the case for dating a claim as carefully as the event it describes
tuples.time_place_scope: a methodological rule for testimony
tuples.mechanism: an explicit dating of the claim, which is the single most useful discipline here
tuples.evidence_lens: the claim dates compared with the event dates across many cases

coverage_profiles.subject: cases that were quietly solved

tuples.episode_object: a disappearance resolved when the person was found living elsewhere
tuples.time_place_scope: a missing-person case closed without publicity
tuples.mechanism: a resolution nobody reported, which is the most common ending of all
tuples.evidence_lens: the closure record compared with the coverage the disappearance received

tuples.episode_object: the right of a found person not to be located to their family
tuples.time_place_scope: a legal position protecting an adult's choice
tuples.mechanism: a legal protection, which resolves a case without informing anyone
tuples.evidence_lens: the legal framework compared with the family's expectations

tuples.episode_object: a wreck identified quietly by a survey and entered in a database
tuples.time_place_scope: a discovery recorded without an announcement

tuples.episode_object: an aircraft loss explained by a technical report nobody read
tuples.time_place_scope: an investigation published in full and never covered
tuples.mechanism: a published answer that did not circulate, which leaves a mystery in public memory

tuples.episode_object: a document authenticated after the controversy had moved on
tuples.time_place_scope: an object examined once attention had faded
tuples.mechanism: a late resolution with no audience, which is the usual timing
tuples.evidence_lens: the analysis results compared with the coverage of the earlier dispute

tuples.episode_object: a signal attributed to a source years after the detection
tuples.time_place_scope: an anomaly resolved in a technical paper

tuples.episode_object: a body identified and the case closed without a public statement
tuples.time_place_scope: an identification handled with the family's wishes respected
tuples.mechanism: a private resolution, which is correct and leaves a public file open
tuples.evidence_lens: the closure record compared with the public case listing

tuples.episode_object: a theft resolved by a recovery that was never announced
tuples.time_place_scope: property returned under an arrangement
tuples.mechanism: a negotiated recovery, which is often confidential by necessity
tuples.evidence_lens: the recovery record compared with the outstanding theft listing

tuples.episode_object: an outbreak whose source was identified in a follow-up paper
tuples.time_place_scope: an investigation concluded long after the news cycle
tuples.mechanism: a delayed publication, which answers a question nobody is still asking
tuples.evidence_lens: the follow-up paper compared with the coverage of the outbreak

tuples.episode_object: a sighting explained by a launch record found later
tuples.time_place_scope: an event resolved by a routine document
tuples.mechanism: a mundane record closing a case, which is how most sightings end
tuples.evidence_lens: the launch records compared with the sighting reports

tuples.episode_object: a cipher solved and published in a specialist journal
tuples.time_place_scope: a solution appearing in a low-circulation venue
tuples.mechanism: a solution published where nobody looks, which leaves the puzzle apparently open
tuples.evidence_lens: the journal publication compared with the popular accounts

tuples.episode_object: a hoax admitted in a local newspaper and never picked up
tuples.time_place_scope: an admission published with a small readership
tuples.mechanism: an admission that did not circulate, which is the usual fate of corrections
tuples.evidence_lens: the local publication compared with the national accounts

tuples.episode_object: a disappearance explained by a coroner's finding years afterwards
tuples.time_place_scope: an inquest held once remains were recovered
tuples.mechanism: a legal resolution arriving late, which does not displace the earlier narrative
tuples.evidence_lens: the inquest record compared with the popular accounts

tuples.episode_object: a monument's date settled by a sample taken during conservation
tuples.time_place_scope: a technical opportunity taken during routine work
tuples.mechanism: a resolution as a by-product of maintenance, which is common and unremarked
tuples.evidence_lens: the conservation report compared with the dating dispute it settled

tuples.episode_object: a missing cargo found in a bonded store during an audit
tuples.time_place_scope: a routine inventory closing an old file
tuples.mechanism: an administrative resolution, which is the least reported and most frequent kind
tuples.evidence_lens: the audit findings compared with the original loss report

tuples.episode_object: a case listed as unsolved in a book after it had been solved
tuples.time_place_scope: a publication working from outdated sources
tuples.mechanism: an out-of-date secondary source, which keeps a solved case in circulation
tuples.evidence_lens: the published account compared with the case's actual status

tuples.episode_object: the register that records a case's status and is not consulted
tuples.time_place_scope: an official listing available and unused
tuples.mechanism: an authoritative source that nobody checks, which sustains a lot of mystery
tuples.evidence_lens: the official register compared with the popular accounts

tuples.episode_object: the researcher who checked twenty famous cases against their files
tuples.time_place_scope: a systematic review of a popular canon
tuples.mechanism: a systematic check, which finds a substantial proportion already resolved
tuples.evidence_lens: the case files compared with the popular accounts of each

tuples.episode_object: the proportion of a popular list that has a documented answer
tuples.time_place_scope: a canon assembled for entertainment rather than accuracy
tuples.mechanism: a measurable error rate in a genre, which is worth stating plainly
tuples.evidence_lens: the popular lists compared with the case records

tuples.episode_object: the case for checking whether a mystery is still a mystery
tuples.time_place_scope: a methodological first step that is almost never taken
tuples.mechanism: a verification step, which should precede every episode in this series
tuples.evidence_lens: the current case records compared with the accounts in circulation

evidence_expectations: Ground each chapter in the kind of record named by the slot, and describe record types rather than citing any specific title, author, archive reference, or file number.
Say in every chapter which statements rest on a document, which rest on testimony, and which rest on neither, and never let the three blur together.
Attribute every claim to the kind of person or body that makes it, and say plainly when a claim has no documentary support at all.
State what a test or a search could establish and what it could not, because in almost every case here that limit is the actual subject.
Never state a date, a distance, a sum, a casualty figure, or a duration more precisely than the record allows, and say when a figure has been revised.
Where a case has a documented resolution, give it; an absent record is an absence, never a proof.
compatibility_rules: Pair only with the sleep history compilation formula; this pack assumes long, independent chapters with no narrative running between them and no tension carried forward.
Use one subject per episode and never mix two, so that a compilation is one kind of case examined many ways rather than an assortment of shocks.
Draw the twenty slots of a subject in any order, but never reuse a slot within one episode set, since each slot is one case or one angle and a repeat would be the same chapter twice.
Do not pair with any formula that opens on a hook, builds tension, promises a revelation, or ends a chapter pointing forward; the exclusions forbid all four and the material does not need them.
